newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields fall on German data.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields fall on German data.

text.p: Swedish bond yields fell on Wednesday morning after weaker than expected German unemployment figures and the crown was firm to the mark.
Ten-year bond yields slid one basis point to 6.56 percent while the six month T-bill rate was one basis point higher at 4.30 percent.
Dealers expected the crown to strengthen further.
"The crown will firm as long as the dollar strengthens against the mark. Once below 4.28 against the mark it could fall to 4.26 fairly rapidly, but it's a bit nervous," one dealer said.

A dealer said the fact that the Riksbank bought crowns on Tuesday at 4.32 to the mark meant the bank was serious about wanting the TCW-index lower. The Riksbank looks at the TCW index and not its level to the mark.
The Swedish Debt Office will issue five billion six-month T-bills at 1050 GMT.
